text:
vAPI Network

 
 
 
 

 One wallet, every x402 API. vapi-network is the open-source, non-custodial
TypeScript client for discovering and paying x402 services in USDC, from a terminal,
an MCP client or your own code. It pays on Base by default and on Arc when you enable
it; Networks lists what works where.

The client gives one local wallet to you and to your agents. You search every x402
catalogue at once, pay an API per call under spend caps you set, and keep a receipt
for each payment. The same wallet gives each agent its own capped account, buys model
access on vAPI Router and moves USDC between your accounts.

vAPI Network builds payment and trust infrastructure for AI agents. Call,
Router, Stake and Agents are live on production. Tasks is coming soon. See
vapinetwork.ai and the
documentation.

vAPI Network is not related to Vapi.ai, the voice AI company.

 Quickstart

This README describes client 0.15.0. npm view vapi-network version shows the latest published release.
The client needs Node.js 22 or newer.

 

No install? Prefix any command with npx vapi-network , for example
 npx vapi-network setup . ( npx vapi cannot work: the bare vapi name on npm
belongs to an unrelated package.)

Back up the recovery phrase only in a terminal; vAPI cannot recover it.
Turn on encrypted cloud backup with vapi backup --cloud ; only the owner can approve a restore.
On a server, a container or GitHub Codespaces, read
Linux without a keyring before vapi setup .

An agent can set itself up from the agent skill. Tell it: "Read
 and follow it to set up vAPI." The same file
ships in this package as SKILL.md, with the
CLI version it describes in its frontmatter.

Interactive CLI runs check for a newer release at most once a day and cache the result in
 /.vapi/update-check.json . JSON, MCP server, CI and non-TTY runs skip the check. Set
 VAPI NO UPDATE CHECK=1 to disable it.

 How a payment works

The device vault encrypts your keys on this machine, using an OS-stored device key
with optional password protection. vAPI applies your spend caps before signing,
sends the payment straight to the service, and writes a local receipt. There is no
payment proxy and no server-side signer. vAPI Call takes no fee; providers are paid
directly.

Local runs keep keys on this machine; experimental Railway runs require explicit
member-key export. Call and discovery metrics are measured locally and nothing is
uploaded unless you send a report yourself. Every payment identifies this client as
 vapi through x402 builder-code ; when an API advertises payment-identifier , the
generated id is kept on that receipt.

 What is in this repository

Everything that runs on your machine is in this repository under the Apache-2.0
license. That covers the wallet and its spend caps, x402 signing, the receipt ledger,
catalogue search, the CLI, the MCP server, the SDK and the desktop app. You can read
how a payment is built and signed before you make one.

The client also talks to hosted vAPI services. Their source is not in this repository.

 Hosted service The client uses it to 
 -------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 vAPI Call search the vAPI registry, and publish or claim a listing 
 Owner link connect this device's accounts to your owner wallet during vapi setup and vapi login 
 vAPI Router buy and use model access, and read your balance and stake status 
 Transfer relay submit a transfer you signed between your own accounts, and pay its gas 
 Cloud backup keep an encrypted vault copy that only the owner can restore 
 Funding page take a card, wallet or bridge deposit and deliver USDC on Base 
 Tasks preview task posting and escrow; coming soon on production 

A payment to an x402 API does not pass through these services. The client signs it
and sends it to the API's own endpoint. Search also reads Coinbase Bazaar, x402scan
and a local file, and VAPI REGISTRY URL points the client at another registry.

 Networks

Payments are in USDC. Base is on by default; you enable the other networks per machine.

 Network Pay x402 APIs Send between accounts Sweep How to enable 
 ----------------------------------- --------------- --------------------- -------------------- ----------------------------------------------------------------- 
 Base mainnet yes yes USDC and ETH on by default 
 Arc mainnet yes yes USDC vapi init --networks base,arc or vapi accounts --enable arc 
 Arc testnet yes no USDC set ARC TESTNET RPC URL 
 Base Sepolia and other EVM networks when configured no USDC when configured add the RPC URL and USDC address to config.json 
 Solana mainnet not yet no no listings are searchable; paying one returns unsupported network 

The hosted funding page delivers USDC on Base. On Arc, USDC is also the gas token.
Identifiers, token addresses and RPC defaults are in
docs/configuration.md.

 Three ways to use it

The CLI, the MCP server and the SDK share one vault, one set of spend caps and one
receipt ledger under /.vapi/ .

Register the MCP server with your agent client, then ask it to "Search vAPI for a
weather API":

 

Call the same client from TypeScript:

 

The MCP server has no tool that reveals a recovery phrase or a private key, and no
tool that creates or retires a listing. The tool list is in docs/mcp.md.

 What you can do

 Surface What it does Guide 
 ------------ ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------ 
 Call Discover, check, publish and pay for x402 APIs. docs/call.md 
 Router Use vAPI Router for model access and balance. docs/router.md 
 Coding tools Run Claude Code and Codex on your daily Compute allowance. docs/code.md 
 Tasks Preview task posting, USDC escrow and delivery; coming soon on production. docs/tasks.md 
 Agents Run capped local agents with dedicated wallets and profiles. docs/agents.md 
 Swarms Group capped local agents around a treasury

install.title: Quickstart
install.html:
This README describes client 0.15.0. npm view vapi-network version shows the latest published release. The client needs Node.js 22 or newer.

npm i -g vapi-network
vapi setup [--no-cloud-backup]   # creates or restores the vault, derives main, links it to your owner wallet; safe to rerun
vapi fund                        # opens the hosted funding page for your address
vapi search "weather"            # every catalogue, merged, with provenance
vapi pay <listing-ref> --max 0.02
vapi receipts                    # one line per paid call: quote, settlement, latency

No install? Prefix any command with npx vapi-network, for example npx vapi-network setup. (npx vapi cannot work: the bare vapi name on npm belongs to an unrelated package.)

Back up the recovery phrase only in a terminal; vAPI cannot recover it. Turn on encrypted cloud backup with vapi backup --cloud; only the owner can approve a restore. On a server, a container or GitHub Codespaces, read Linux without a keyring before vapi setup.

An agent can set itself up from the agent skill. Tell it: "Read https://vapinetwork.ai/SKILL.md and follow it to set up vAPI." The same file ships in this package as SKILL.md, with the CLI version it describes in its frontmatter.

Interactive CLI runs check for a newer release at most once a day and cache the result in ~/.vapi/update-check.json. JSON, MCP server, CI and non-TTY runs skip the check. Set VAPI_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 to disable it.
